name: reader-strip
title: Reader Strip
description: A vertical strip of page images for scroll (webtoon) reading, centred, full width on phones and at most 720px (or the widest page) on desktop. It follows the page scroll or the nearest scroll parent: no inner scroll box. Each page is a
docs: Import from "@/components/manga/reader-strip". Give every page its real width and height so the space is reserved before the image arrives. Pair it with ReadingProgress (value = ratio * 100) for a progress bar.

meta.tagline: Pages in a vertical strip, for scroll reading.

props.name: pages
props.type: { src: string; alt: string; width: number; height: number }[]
props.description: The page images, in reading order. width / height reserve the space.

props.name: gap
props.description: Space between pages; "none" joins them without frames.

props.name: onProgress
props.description: Scroll progress through the strip (0-1) and the page being read (0-based): the last page whose top has crossed the reading line, a third of the way down the visible view under its sticky header; the last page once the strip's bottom is in view.

props.name: onEnd
props.description: Called each time the end panel comes into view.

props.name: onRetry
props.description: Called when the reader retries a failed page (e.g. to switch source).
